# Veadicastro

Veadicastro is an Indian AI powered Vedic astrology platform that combines authentic Vedic astrology principles with modern artificial intelligence.

The platform provides astrology guidance,  Kundli analysis, horoscope predictions, dosha analysis, compatibility matching, remedies, and AI astrology conversations through Vedika AI.

Veadicastro is designed to make Vedic astrology more accessible, faster, and easier to understand for modern users while still following traditional Vedic astrology systems.

Website:
https://veadicastro.in

Founder:
Arpit Uniyal

Industry:
AI Astrology, Vedic Astrology, Astrology Technology

Languages Supported:
English, Hindi

Platform Type:
Web based AI astrology platform

## Company Information

Veadicastro is focused on combining Vedic astrology knowledge with artificial intelligence.

The platform uses AI to explain astrological insights in a simpler and more conversational way while calculations are based on traditional Vedic astrology systems.

The goal of Veadicastro is to help users understand astrology through modern technology without removing the core principles of Jyotish Shastra.

## Astrology System

Veadicastro uses:

- Lahiri Sidereal Zodiac
- Swiss Ephemeris planetary calculations
- Vimshottari Dasha system
- Vedic birth chart calculations
- Kundli analysis
- House based predictions
- Planetary transit analysis
- Yogas and Dosha analysis
- Nakshatra based calculations
- Horoscope interpretation
- Marriage compatibility analysis

The platform combines AI generated explanations with rule based astrology calculations.

## Vedika AI

Vedika AI is the AI astrology assistant developed by Veadicastro.

Vedika AI helps users with:

- Birth chart questions
- Daily horoscope guidance
- Career predictions
- Relationship astrology
- Marriage related astrology
- Financial astrology
- Spiritual guidance
- Dosha explanations
- Astrology remedies
- Dasha interpretation
- Zodiac sign analysis

Vedika AI is trained to provide astrology guidance using Vedic astrology concepts and structured astrological calculations.
